text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Since autumn 2023, three terraced houses in a residential area in Basel have been connected to a ground source heat pump and two gas heating systems to form a micro-district heating network.", "gist": "Three Basel houses form a micro-district heating network using a heat pump and gas systems since autumn 2023."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "more than 90 per cent", "gist": "Over 90% of heating was renewable energy from heat pump"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "15 per cent", "gist": "Heating cost was 15% lower than before"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "300,000", "gist": "Potential for 300,000 Swiss properties in need of heating solution"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The micro-district heating network could be a solution for around 300,000 properties in Switzerland that are adjacent to at least one other house in need of a heating solution.", "gist": "Micro-district heating network could serve 300,000 Swiss properties near other houses needing heating"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Technically, the micro-district heating network is easy to realise.", "gist": "Micro-district heating network is technically easy to implement"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The idea, which originated in Basel, therefore has the potential to be used throughout Switzerland.", "gist": "Basel-originated idea could be used nationwide in Switzerland"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Special Jury Award", "gist": "Award given to this project"}]}
